scope: One fixed seven-feature acceptance-trajectory bundle ablation using saved lines. No engines, collection, app changes, ratings, deployment or general tooling. Same grouped evaluation.
feature_protocol: FEATURE-PROTOCOL.json, separately frozen before extraction; feature hashes frozen before evaluation
feature_policy: Opponent-best acceptance per window, same selection as prior gap; chosen best-response line; original-mover material and score; truncated observations remain missing; no eligibility changes. Seven values plus missing indicators.

evaluation.threshold_rule: Max innerOOF TP with FP<=fixedoriginal reference FP AND wrong-award fraction<=fixedoriginal reference. Same exact-score threshold selection/ties as previous study.
evaluation.selection: Same inner selection: maximum true positives then fewer false positives; ties prefer custom_fixed, custom_retuned, standard_rf, custom_trajectory, standard_rf_trajectory. No outer-label selection.
evaluation.control: Original150 columns unchanged; append seven trajectory values and seven missing flags. Same hyperparameters, rows, weights, guards, group folds and seeds. mtry remains12 (sqrt150 and sqrt164 round down to12). No conditional-gap feature in this isolated bundle ablation; previous gap study remains a historical comparison.
evaluation.primary_reporting: Pooled nested held-out counts for each arm, paired differences and selected procedure. No posthoc winner or threshold sweep.
evaluation.sensitivity: Report scores on outer TEST rows excluding every pilot whole group. Training folds may include pilot groups when legal. This is a non-pilot-case breakdown, not new independent validation.
evaluation.final_calibration: Same separate5fold final calibration; train/freeze one selected fullfit. No replay on already-seen654 in this experiment; leave fresh validation for later.

interpretation: Development evidence on repeatedly used corpus.48label-informed pilot examples generated feature hypothesis; nonpilot breakdown does not erase adaptive-study bias. No deployment claim.
stop: No outcome-dependent retries, cutoffs or model sweeps. No repeated654benchmark replay.
